title: Τῶν παρ' Ἱπποκράτει λέξεων συναγωγή / Glossary of Hippocratic Words / «Собрание гиппократовских слов»
author: Erotian (Erotianus)
date: c. 60s CE (dedicated to Nero's physician Andromachus)
size: About 100 pp. in Nachmanson's edition (estimate 10–12k words).
edition: E. Nachmanson, Erotiani Vocum Hippocraticarum collectio (Uppsala 1918; PD).
ru_evidence: No ru.wikipedia article. Listed without any translation in the ru.wikipedia list of surviving Greek works. None found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia (Erotianus) lists none. OpenAlex search found none.
value: The earliest list of Hippocratic works, plus Hellenistic medical lexicography (fragments of Bacchius and Glaucias). Important for history of medicine and of the Hippocratic text.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: short glosses; identifying the Hippocratic passages needs expert checking.
pilot_unit: Preface with the list of works, plus letters Α–Γ (estimate 3k words).
